sentences.en: Toenails clicked on concrete behind her and panting announced that Brutus had arrived for his breakfast.

sentences.en: The major, and most painful conditions include bunions, blisters and sores, ingrown toenails, cracks and fungus.

sentences.en: Suitable problems include sebaceous cysts, skin tags, in-growing toenails and moles.
sentences.vi: Các vấn đề phù hợp bao gồm u nang bã nhờn, da thẻ, móng chân đang phát triển và nốt ruồi.

sentences.en: Ringworm is a skin infection caused by fungus that can affect the scalp, skin, fingers, toenails, or feet.

sentences.en: If you do have poor sensation, you need to take special care to avoid injury, including when cutting toenails.
